newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 5.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
-- Young people of China should hold high great banner of building socialism with Chinese characteristics initiated by Deng Xiaoping, President Jiang Zemin tells young people in Beijing
- Chinese Premier Li Peng says in Victoria China will continue to develop traditional friendship with Seychelles.
- Chinese President Jiang Zemin expresses hope China and African countries can become "all-weather" friends.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Premier Li Peng urges China's television networks to give greater coverage to "dark side" of economy and to meet growing needs for economic information.
- Hangzhou University marks 100th anniversary of its founding
CHINA SECURITIES
- Sichuan Changhong is first among top 10 listed firms in terms net profit in 1996
- Sales to production rate of large enterprises exceeds that of small and medium enterprises
- Vice Minister of Foreign Trade says listing of Minmetals company is good trial for reform of state-owned enterprises
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Large number of farmers return home to invest in agriculture after making money labouring in cities
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Economic growth rate of central China is 0.9 percentae points faster than eastern China
- Largest information network for grain and edible oils is set up
CHINA DAILY
- State favours mergers for unprofitable firms
- Central bank bans depositing public funds in private accounts
